errorCodes.meaning: The community has badges turned off (VTI-BDG-004). Nothing was stored.
The signer is neither an active member who may make a kudos badge or who owns a badge, nor a holder of `vtc.badges.admin`. Nothing was stored.
`data` decodes to more than 262144 bytes, or to a picture larger than the community decodes — more pixels, or more memory to decode, than its bound. Nothing was stored.
`data` does not decode as an image of `mediaType`, or as an image the community can re-encode. Nothing was stored.
The signer has uploaded as many images as the community allows in its current window. Nothing was stored.

CardBlobRef.description: A content-addressed image held in the community's blob store — an avatar or an `image` field. At most 256 KiB, images only, re-encoded by the community on upload (vtc/directory/images/upload: metadata stripped, dimensions capped) so its digest does not link the member across communities. A viewer reads the bytes with vtc/directory/images/get, which answers only where the same projection shows the value. `url` and `urlExpiresAt` MAY appear in a projection: a short-lived URL the community checks against the same projection, so a member-only image is never a public URL. A community that does not offer one leaves both out.

mediaType.description: Media type of the stored bytes.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the stored, re-encoded bytes.

size.description: Size in bytes of the stored bytes.

url.description: Projection only: a URL the viewer can fetch the image from until `urlExpiresAt`.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

ImageMediaType.description: The media types a directory image may have — those a `CardBlobRef` admits.
ImageMediaType.title: ImageMediaType

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/images/upload/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/images/upload/0.1#response.

expiresAt.description: When the community erases the image if no badge holds it by then.

image.description: The stored, re-encoded image, without `url` or `urlExpiresAt`. A badge holds this as its picture; the signer names its `sha256` in vtc/badges/create, update or promote.

schema.description: A badge administrator, owner or member hands the community the picture for a badge. The community re-encodes it and answers the reference a badge holds. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

data.description: The image, base64url without padding (RFC 4648 §5). At most 262144 bytes decoded.

mediaType.description: The media type of `data` as sent. The community may store another: it re-encodes.
